comments.author: @NN-hg4em
comments.text: Very unfortunate victim of our avarice. What you measure in the air is only one small component of the lasting radioactive footprint locked in the soil the trees and mountains that absorbed the release of radioactivity. The runoff is contaminated the trees can never be burned and soil never disturbed for generations. The cleanup of the plant itself will long go past the age of our grandchildren. It exceeded the level of Chernobyl. That disaster continues to cause environmental problems. Don't be one dimensional here. Look at Fukushima in its entirety. What an unjust legacy to hand down to future generations.
